Ayah marker number placement

Each marker drawn with one, two and three Arabic-Indic digits placed in the recorded number box (dashed outline). font-shaping means the box was read out of the source font's own U+06DD enclosure; derived means the font does not enclose and the box comes from the geometry of the marker's interior.

Set a number centre

Click a marker part to select it, then centre the number from its bounds. Clicking blank space clears the selection and moves nothing. One centre serves every digit count, so all three boxes move together. Placements save themselves as you go.

Click a marker part to begin.

The centre is shared by the 1–3 digit boxes.
